title: Poem of Emberlight

outfit_card.silhouette: A fitted, corseted bodice with a layered, voluminous mermaid-style skirt. Features an off-shoulder neckline with puffed, sheer cap sleeves. The asymmetric hem is gathered and swept to one side, creating a dramatic, sweeping train effect.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate gold headband with a central red gem, complemented by small, sculpted red floral hairpins and a fine gold chain draping across the crown.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A deep red, off-shoulder bodice with a sweetheart neckline, intricately woven with gold floral jacquard and flame-like motifs. The short, puffed sleeves are made of sheer black organza, finished with a subtle, ruffled collar and a delicate red ribbon choker.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A sweeping, layered skirt featuring a textured, voluminous red overskirt with a quilted, almost rose-like drape. Beneath, a black tulle underlayer is overlaid with a striking red and gold lattice-patterned sheer fabric, cascading into a dramatic, trailing hem.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A small, stylized black and white cat companion wearing a matching red and black cape. The outfit is accented with scattered red rose motifs and a fine, gold chain detailing trailing from the bodice.
